headline: How to do cat eye nails
shareable_line: Wet polish moves. Set polish doesn't.

scenes.say: Cat eye polish looks so shiny in the bottle, but flat on your nails? It's almost always the timing, not the polish.
First, paint one nail with a thin coat. Then pick up the magnet right away, while the polish is still wet.
scenes.label: Step 1
scenes.check: One thin coat, magnet right away

scenes.say: Hold the magnet just above the nail for about ten seconds. Close, but never touching the polish.
scenes.label: Step 2

scenes.say: For a soft velvet look, sweep the magnet slowly from side to side instead of holding it still. Finish that nail, then move on to the next.
scenes.label: Step 3
scenes.check: Sweep side to side for velvet

scenes.say: The common mistake is painting all ten nails first and using the magnet at the end. By then the polish has started to set, and the shine can't move.
scenes.label: Common mistake

scenes.say: Wet polish moves. Set polish doesn't. The shopping link is in my profile.
